newsitem.title: HONG KONG: New World PCS HK$1.5 billion loan allotted.
newsitem.headline: New World PCS HK$1.5 billion loan allotted.

text.p: New World PCS Ltd's HK$1.5 billion loan facility has been closed, coordinating arranger Deutsche Bank Hong Kong said.
The loan size was increased to HK$2 billion due to oversubscription but was scaled back to the original amount of HK$1.5 billion.
New World Development will guarantee 85 percent of the loan, while Thailand's Total Access Communication PCL will guarantee the remaining 15 percent.
The amortising loan has a final maturity of eight years with a put option in year five. It will pay a margin of 75 basis points over the Hong Kong Interbank Offered Rate.
Proceeds are to be used for the company's development of the next generation of mobile communications.
Coordinating arranger Deutsche Bank Hong Kong committed HK$155 million. Other arrangers, with HK$150 million each, are BNP Hong Kong and Hang Seng Bank.
Senior lead managers, with HK$95 million each, are Bank of Nova Scotia, HypoBank, DBS, Mitsubishi Trust and Banking Corp, OCBC, Sanwa Bank, SE Banken, Sumitomo Trust, UOB, WestLB and Wing Lung Bank.
